site.name: Amal Gafoor P K
about: I'm a graduate from NIT Calicut who spent the last year building AI systems. I believe it's time to build infrastructure around AI (LLMs) that drives a shift as big as the internet and industrial revolutions.

I build things that actually work in production — RAG pipelines, agentic AI systems, async backends. What excites me is the gap between "AI demos" and "AI that doesn't break under load": session management, rate limiting, retrieval quality, and the boring infrastructure that makes AI reliable.

projects.title: Flowtropic
projects.blurb: Full conversational AI sales agent for Instagram. Handles DMs end-to-end with multimodal RAG over product catalogues, session memory in Redis, and a Next.js dashboard for the business.

projects.title: Agentic ReAct Architecture
projects.blurb: An agentic ReAct system designed specifically to eliminate LLM hallucination — every claim is grounded through tool calls and verified before it reaches the user.

projects.title: B2B Sales Automation
projects.blurb: Pipeline that researches prospects, drafts outreach and keeps the CRM current — the manual part of B2B sales, automated.

projects.title: Industrial Gasifier Digital Twin
projects.blurb: Intelligent digital twin of an industrial gasifier with live sensor integration and an AI expert agent that explains plant state and recommends actions.

projects.title: License Plate Detection
projects.blurb: Detects and reads vehicle number plates from images and video frames using a trained detection model.

projects.title: Syllabus Pacer
projects.blurb: A family of study-pacing apps (Commerce, Humanities, 12th, 9th) that turn a syllabus into a day-by-day plan.

projects.title: Time-table Scheduler
projects.blurb: Generates clash-free class timetables from faculty, room and subject constraints, with the logic pushed down into PostgreSQL.
